snippet.title: Apple Crumble Announcement Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Happy Broccoli Games, the team behind the much beloved Duck Detective series (5000+ ‘overwhelmingly positive’ reviews on Steam) have announced their next project at today’s Story-Rich Showcase: Apple Crumble! 

Apple Crumble is a fully-voiced interactive mystery thriller inspired by the likes of MOUTHWASHING and Knives Out. It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. How about some pudding?

Wishlist Apple Crumble now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110770/
